newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico November manufacturing employment rises.
newsitem.headline: Mexico November manufacturing employment rises.

text.p: Employment in Mexico's manufacturing sector rose 4.3 percent in November, compared with the same month a year earlier, the National Statistics Institute INEGI said on Tuesday.
It said this was the eighth consecutive monthly increase in manufactauring employment.

The government's institute said that employment rose in eight of the nine divisions in the sector, with the largest increases seen in metal, machine and equipment products, in textiles, in apparel and leather, and in "other manufacturing industries."
